items.title: Orchid Planners, Bharatpur, Chitwan
items.body:
The internship at Orchid Planner, Bharatpur-10, Chitwan, provided a valuable opportunity to 
gain practical experience in various aspects of building and structural engineering. During the 
internship period, I was involved in a range of technical activities, including architectural and 
structural drawing preparation, RCC and steel building planning, structural modeling and 
analysis using ETABS, reinforcement detailing, quantity estimation and BOQ preparation, cost 
estimation, and site investigation and non-destructive testing.

Working under the guidance of experienced engineers enhanced my technical knowledge and 
helped me understand the practical application of engineering principles, design procedures, 
and relevant building standards. The internship also provided exposure to professional 
engineering software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion as well as D5, ETABS, and 
Microsoft Excel. Limited participation in site visits further helped me understand field 
measurements, construction practices, structural inspection, and the use of equipment such as the rebound hammer, ultrasonic testing equipment, laser level, Laser Measure and auto level.  

Overall, the internship successfully helped bridge the gap between theoretical academic 
knowledge and practical engineering applications. It improved my confidence in handling 
engineering drawings, structural analysis, estimation, documentation, and field activities, 
while providing a strong foundation for my future professional career in civil engineering
